examples.en: Ella visits her old school once in a blue moon.
examples.zh: 極少回訪以前就讀的學校。

examples.en: We eat at that restaurant once in a blue moon.
examples.zh: 我們極少到那間餐廳用膳。

meaning.zh: 極少；非常罕有；幾乎從不。

register.summaryEn: The expression is informal but widely understood. It is natural in everyday conversation, interviews, stories, informal workplace communication and general-interest writing. Oxford and Collins both mark it as informal.
register.summaryZh: 這是一個非正式但非常常見的慣用語，適合用於日常對話、訪問、故事、一般職場溝通及通俗文章。
register.formalEn: In highly formal reports, academic writing or legal documents, rarely, very seldom or only on rare occasions may be more suitable.
register.formalZh: 倒裝句中使用的助動詞

fixedVariable.fixedEn: Keep the fixed words and word order shown in the source expression.
fixedVariable.fixedZh: 保留原檔目標表達中的固定字詞及字序。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Change only the verb form, possessive, tense or surrounding grammar permitted by the source patterns.
fixedVariable.variableZh: 只按照原檔句式改變動詞形式、所有格、時態或前後文法。

forms.form: Subject + verb + object/complement + once in a blue moon.
forms.example: Ella visits her old school once in a blue moon.

forms.form: Once in a blue moon, + subject + verb.
forms.example: Once in a blue moon, our teacher ends the lesson early.

forms.form: Opening phrase/clause + subject + verb + once in a blue moon.
forms.example: Because she lives overseas, my cousin visits us once in a blue moon.

forms.form: Subject + usual situation + and/but, once in a blue moon, + rare action.
forms.example: Our dog usually ignores strangers but, once in a blue moon, barks at one.

forms.form: Subject + verb + only once in a blue moon.
forms.example: The hotel offers free upgrades only once in a blue moon.

forms.form: Only once in a blue moon + do/does/did + subject + base verb.
forms.example: Only once in a blue moon does the head teacher teach our class.

forms.form: It + is/was + only once in a blue moon + that + clause.
forms.example: It is only once in a blue moon that the theatre shows silent films.

forms.form: Event/opportunity + happens/occurs/comes along + once in a blue moon.
forms.example: A chance like this comes along once in a blue moon.

forms.form: Subject + may/can/could/will + verb + once in a blue moon.
forms.example: The school may close early once in a blue moon.

forms.form: Subject + do/does not + verb + once in a blue moon; + frequent reality.
forms.example: These mistakes do not happen once in a blue moon; they happen every week.

specificForms.formula: Subject + verb + object/complement + once in a blue moon.
specificForms.descriptionEn: This is the most common and easiest teaching position.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 這是最常見，亦最適合初學者掌握的位置。

examples.en: Ella visits her old school once in a blue moon.
examples.zh: 極少回訪以前就讀的學校。

examples.en: We eat at that restaurant once in a blue moon.
examples.zh: 我們極少到那間餐廳用膳。

specificForms.formula: Once in a blue moon, + subject + verb.
specificForms.descriptionEn: Use a comma after the opening expression.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 慣用語放在句首時，後面應使用逗號。

examples.en: Once in a blue moon, our teacher ends the lesson early.
examples.zh: 老師極少會提早下課。

examples.en: Once in a blue moon, the town gets snow.
examples.zh: 這個小鎮極少下雪。

specificForms.titleEn: After a Time, Reason or Contrast Phrase
specificForms.titleZh: 放在時間、原因或對比內容之後
specificForms.formula: Opening phrase/clause + subject + verb + once in a blue moon.
specificForms.descriptionEn: The opening phrase carries separate information and must remain in the sentence.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 句首部分提供額外的原因或時間資料，因此不能因加入慣用語而刪除。

examples.en: Because she lives overseas, my cousin visits us once in a blue moon.
examples.zh: 由於表妹居於海外，她極少探望我們。

examples.en: Since leaving the company, he sees his former colleagues once in a blue moon.
examples.zh: 離開公司後，他極少再見以前的同事。

specificForms.formula: Subject + usual situation + and/but, once in a blue moon, + rare action.
specificForms.descriptionEn: This position highlights a rare exception to a normal pattern. It is useful, but it should not dominate a beginner exercise.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 這個位置用來突出日常規律中的罕有例外。 它十分實用，但不應在初階練習中過度使用。

examples.en: Our dog usually ignores strangers but, once in a blue moon, barks at one.
examples.zh: 我們的狗通常不理會陌生人，但極少數情況下會向陌生人吠叫。

examples.en: She normally travels alone and, once in a blue moon, takes her brother with her.
examples.zh: 她通常獨自旅行，但極少會帶弟弟同行。

specificForms.titleZh: 配合 only 的一般語序
specificForms.formula: Subject + verb + only once in a blue moon.
specificForms.descriptionEn: Only is optional. It adds emphasis but is not part of the fixed expression.
specificForms.descriptionZh: only 是可選的強調詞，並不是固定慣用語的一部分。

examples.en: The hotel offers free upgrades only once in a blue moon.
examples.zh: 酒店只有極少數情況才會提供免費客房升級。

examples.en: I wear a suit only once in a blue moon.
examples.zh: 我極少穿西裝。

specificForms.formula: Only once in a blue moon + do/does/did + subject + base verb.
specificForms.descriptionEn: When only once in a blue moon is moved to the front, the auxiliary verb comes before the subject.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 當 only once in a blue moon 放在句首時，助動詞必須移到主語之前。

examples.en: Only once in a blue moon does the head teacher teach our class.
examples.zh: 校長極少親自教我們這一班。

examples.en: Only once in a blue moon did the former manager praise the staff.
examples.zh: 以前那位經理極少稱讚員工。

specificForms.formula: It + is/was + only once in a blue moon + that + clause.
specificForms.descriptionEn: This pattern places strong focus on the rarity of the event.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 這個句式會強烈突出事情發生得非常罕有。

examples.en: It is only once in a blue moon that the theatre shows silent films.
examples.zh: 這間戲院極少放映默片。

examples.en: It was only once in a blue moon that our former manager joined us for lunch.
examples.zh: 以前那位經理極少與我們一起吃午飯。

specificForms.titleEn: An Event or Opportunity as the Subject
specificForms.formula: Event/opportunity + happens/occurs/comes along + once in a blue moon.
specificForms.descriptionEn: The subject does not have to be a person.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 主語不一定是人，也可以是一件事件、問題或機會。

examples.en: A chance like this comes along once in a blue moon.
examples.zh: 這種機會極為罕有。

examples.en: A problem like this occurs once in a blue moon.
examples.zh: 這類問題極少發生。

specificForms.titleEn: With a Modal or Future Form
specificForms.titleZh: 配合情態動詞或將來式
specificForms.formula: Subject + may/can/could/will + verb + once in a blue moon.
specificForms.descriptionEn: The modal verb expresses possibility. The idiom expresses frequency. Neither replaces the other.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 情態動詞表示可能性； 慣用語表示頻率。 兩者的功能不同，不能互相取代。

examples.en: The school may close early once in a blue moon.
examples.zh: 學校極少數情況下可能會提早關門。

examples.en: You may see the owner here once in a blue moon.
examples.zh: 你極少會在這裏見到店主。

specificForms.formula: Subject + do/does not + verb + once in a blue moon; + frequent reality.
specificForms.descriptionEn: This advanced pattern denies that an event is rare.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 這個較進階的句式用來否定某件事十分罕有。

examples.en: These mistakes do not happen once in a blue moon; they happen every week.
examples.zh: 這些錯誤並非極少發生，而是每星期都會出現。

benefits.en: The idiomatic version packages the meaning into one memorable expression.
benefits.zh: 我極少到那個地區。 慣用語版本能以一個容易記憶的表達，濃縮「幾乎從不」的意思。

examples.en: I visit that area once in a blue moon.
examples.zh: 我極少到那個地區。

benefits.en: The expression clearly separates the normal pattern from the unusual exception.
benefits.zh: 她通常拒絕邀請，但極少數情況下會加入我們。 這個表達能清楚區分平常規律和極少出現的例外。

examples.en: She normally refuses invitations but, once in a blue moon, joins us.
examples.zh: 她通常拒絕邀請，但極少數情況下會加入我們。

benefits.en: Once in a blue moon is more vivid and conversational.
benefits.zh: 準確而中性； once in a blue moon 則較生動，亦較有日常對話色彩。

benefits.en: The expression is useful when encouraging someone not to waste an unusual opportunity.
benefits.zh: 這種機會十分難得。 當說話者希望勸告別人不要錯過罕有機會時，這個表達十分實用。

examples.en: A chance like this comes along once in a blue moon.
examples.zh: 這種機會十分難得。

benefits.en: This use allows the speaker to challenge the claim that something is rare. The idiom is useful, but it is not automatically better than rarely. Use it when the informal tone and strong emphasis genuinely suit the context.
benefits.zh: 這些問題並非極少發生，而是每天都會出現。 這種用法讓說話者反駁「某件事十分罕有」的說法。 這個慣用語十分實用，但不一定比 rarely 更好。 只有當非正式語氣和強調效果適合相關語境時， 才應使用。

examples.en: These problems do not happen once in a blue moon; they happen every day.
examples.zh: 這些問題並非極少發生，而是每天都會出現。

origin.statusZh: 逐漸形成；確切來源不明

history.en: Merriam-Webster identifies an 1821 London example in which blue moon referred to a very long period of time. A note in that work explained that the expression suggested a long interval, indicating that it was already used as London slang. Its earlier development remains uncertain.
history.zh: 找到一個1821年的倫敦例子，當中的 blue moon 表示一段很長的時間。 該作品的註釋亦解釋這個說法表示長時間，可見當時它已是倫敦口語，但更早期的演變仍不清楚。

history.en: The idea of waiting through an extremely long and unusual “blue moon” interval naturally developed into the meaning “very rarely”. The full form once in a blue moon then became a conventional way of describing actions and events that almost never happen.
history.zh: 等待極為漫長而罕有的「藍月」時刻，自然可以引申為「極少發生」。 完整說法 once in a blue moon 後來逐漸固定，用來描述幾乎不會發生的行動和事件。

origin.memoryEn: A blue-looking moon would be highly unusual; an action that happens once in a blue moon is also highly unusual.
origin.memoryZh: 藍色月亮是罕有景象；once in a blue moon 所描述的事情同樣極少發生。

rules.en: blue moon once once in a blue moon
Both are complete sentences. I visit the area only once in a blue moon.

rules.titleZh: 規則三：慣用語表示「極少」
rules.en: from time to time This may simply mean that she swims from time to time. She occasionally goes swimming. She goes swimming once in a blue moon. She almost never goes swimming.
rules.zh: 較弱的原句： 這句可能只表示她間中游泳，未必罕有至適合使用目標慣用語。 較強的原句： 自然答案：

rules.titleEn: Use It for Repeatable Events or Recognisable Types of Opportunity
rules.en: Being born is not a repeated personal habit or a recurring type of event. A chance like this comes along once in a blue moon. I was born once in a blue moon.
rules.zh: 用於可以重複的事情或某一類罕有機會不適合： 出生並不是個人會重複進行的習慣，也不是在這個語境中反覆出現的一類事件。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Treat It as an Exact Timetable
rules.titleZh: 規則五：不要把它理解為準確時間表
rules.en: It communicates general rarity rather than a mathematically exact interval.
rules.zh: 不要把它理解為準確時間表

rules.titleZh: 規則六：句首 only 後必須使用倒裝
rules.en: Only once in a blue moon he arrives early. Only once in a blue moon does he arrive early.

rules.titleEn: Use the Base Verb After Do, Does or Did
rules.en: Only once in a blue moon did she cooked. Only once in a blue moon does she cook. Only once in a blue moon did she cook. Only once in a blue moon does she cooks.
rules.zh: do、does 或 did 後使用動詞原形正確： 錯誤： 錯誤：

rules.en: No comma is normally required before a simple sentence-final expression. Once in a blue moon, we eat outside. We usually stay home but, once in a blue moon, eat outside. We eat outside once in a blue moon.
rules.zh: 按照位置使用逗號句中插入： 句末： 慣用語簡單放在句末時，前面通常不需要逗號。

rules.titleEn: Do Not Confuse the Idiom with the Astronomical Noun
rules.en: There will be a Blue Moon this month. The astronomical expression is a separate noun phrase. NASA currently explains a monthly Blue Moon as the second full moon appearing within one calendar month.
rules.zh: 我們極少露營。 本月將出現一次天文學上所稱的「藍月」。 不要把慣用語與天文名詞混淆

examples.en: We go camping once in a blue moon.
examples.zh: 我們極少露營。

rules.titleEn: Related Forms Are Not the Target of This Exercise
rules.titleZh: 規則十：相關形式不是本練習的目標
rules.en: once in a blue moon every once in a blue moon
rules.zh: every once in a blue moon 在真實英語中可以出現，但 every 並不是本練習所選目標的一部分。

instructions.en: Rewrite or respond to each item using once in a blue moon.
instructions.zh: 使用 once in a blue moon 改寫句子或完成回應。
